item.title: US Federal Reserve lowers interest rates for third time this year
item.description: The Fed cut its benchmark interest rate by a quarter point to a range of 3.25% to 3.5%, citing a weakening jobs market, although two policymakers voted against.

item.title: Bank of England holds interest rates at 4% as inflation stays sticky
item.description: The Bank of England kept interest rates on hold at 4%, with the Monetary Policy Committee split 6-3, as UK inflation remained stuck at 3.8%.

item.title: Crypto lender Nimbus accused by US regulator of misleading 90,000 savers
item.description: The SEC alleges Nimbus Lending and its founder, Mark Ellery, ran a $1.2bn scheme that promised crypto investors returns of up to 14%.

item.title: Business live: FTSE 100 edges higher as pound steadies before Fed decision
item.description: Rolling coverage of the latest economic and financial news, as markets await the Bank of England and US Federal Reserve.
